$comment: Process-enforcement hooks for the academic paper workflow. Commands go through scripts/hooks/run.sh (POSIX sh), which execs the Windows 'py' launcher when present and falls back to 'python3' on macOS/Linux -- one settings file for every platform (Claude Code on Windows ships with Git Bash, so 'sh' is available there). Hook paths are anchored to $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR so they keep working after the agent cd's elsewhere (a relative path silently disabled every gate, exit 127). Hooks fail open (a hook error never blocks work).
